findings.citation: WAI-ARIA dialog pattern: a dialog has an accessible name (aria-labelledby resolves to a rendered heading); DESIGN.md dialog composition
findings.note: The reveal step has no accessible name in all four dialogs: its heading uses a local useId nothing references, while DialogShell's aria-labelledby points at the confirm/form heading that unmounts on the swap; Add agent and Add tester pass no titleId at all. Fix: let the reveal take the parent's titleId (and wire titleId on the two creation dialogs). Add a test asserting the dialog's name on each step.

findings.citation: DESIGN.md: Inter end to end; its 'One-time password reveal' entry and spec Design direction: '.tnum with wide tracking'
findings.note: The password field uses font-mono (system monospace), the only font-mono in the codebase. Drop it (tnum + wide tracking per DESIGN.md and spec).

findings.citation: docs/agents/coding-standards.md Backend 12: "Table-driven tests (@ParameterizedTest + @MethodSource) for any method with more than two branch conditions, instead of copy-pasted per-case tests."
findings.note: LoginAdministrationGuard.requireCanAdminister has three refusal conditions, tested by four per-case @Test methods. Make it table-driven and add the TESTER-target allowed case. (Renaming the class to LoginAdministrationGuardTest, smell F10, fits here.)

findings.citation: spec.md Design direction: "The Testers table's new column follows the existing table cell rhythm (px-4, py-2.5–3), with the action right-aligned."
findings.note: Th is text-left and the Td has no alignment, so the action is left-aligned (golden confirms). Right-align header and cell. (The design audit raised the same.)

findings.citation: spec.md Frontend: "On close after a reset ... an always-mounted polite status region announces \"Password reset for {email}.\"" (story 13: resetting the same Login again is the normal recovery)
findings.note: onReset sets the same string on a second reset of the same Login, so the output text does not change and nothing is announced. Make each reset produce a fresh announcement. (The design audit raised the same.)

findings.citation: spec.md Journeys: "The journey's proofs, manager-entity-setup.spec.ts and create-agent-with-login.spec.ts, are rewritten to read the shown password and sign in with it, so they keep proving the journey."
findings.note: manager-entity-setup only checks the Generated password field is visible and clicks Done; it never signs in. Add the sign-in with the revealed password.
Test-only one-argument constructor hides `new PasswordGenerator()`; tests should pass it explicitly and the constructor and @Autowired go.
Mysterious Name: tests LoginAdministrationGuard, nothing Agent-specific; rename LoginAdministrationGuardTest.
Duplicated JSON pass-through across five routes (two new); a JSON counterpart to lib/api/forward-binary.ts would remove it.
Duplicated form-or-reveal state and swap across the three creation dialogs.
Polite status is empty:hidden (display:none) while empty, so 'Copied' may not be announced; a repeat Copy is not re-announced.

aria-label="Actions" on the cell overrides its content for screen readers; the sr-only header already gives the context. [Fix pass: left — dropping the aria-label makes the cell's name contain the email, and Playwright's getByRole('cell',{name}) matches substrings, breaking the e2e addTester helper.]
Long emails do not wrap in the dialog title and body (and the reveal at :53-57); AgentSignInEmail already uses break-all.
Focus is lost while submitting and stays lost on error (Button disables itself when loading); shared Button behaviour.
Heading-to-body spacing differs between confirm (mt-1) and reveal steps.
Reveal heading says 'Login created' after Add agent, where the Agent itself was also created (copy matches spec).
A Tester's confirm repeats the email in title and body (name == email; spec-decided).
After 'no longer exists' the link goes to the Clients list rather than refreshing this Client (matches spec wording).
At mobile width the row action needs a horizontal table scroll (spec accepts TableScroll).
Copy password (sm, 28px) beside a 36px field; heights don't align (sm is DESIGN.md-mandated).
Stub reveal password k7Qm-x2Vd-9Rtw uses uppercase outside the real alphabet; the golden shows an impossible password. Use e.g. k7mq-x3vh-p9te.
The Agent glossary entry still says creation takes an 'email and temporary password'; stale now that it is generated.
A repeated Escape in Chromium can close the dialog mid-request (CloseWatcher), losing the new password with no feedback; pre-existing guard.
Dialog lacks overscroll-behavior: contain (pre-existing, every Manager dialog).
Email placeholders don't end with '…' (existing house style).
@Transactional on controller methods (Backend 3), pre-existing and already in docs/tech-debt.md.
